presets.name: Wide clean
presets.desc: A mono guitar spread into a fine-grained stereo image; the mono fold is the dry, exactly
presets.notes: The default: correlation about 0.47, each side within ±2 dB in bands; level -1.3 dB matches the bypass in stereo

presets.name: Live safe
presets.desc: Moderate width that survives any PA: exact mono fold at the bypassed level, lows mono, attacks centred
presets.notes: Level stays 0 dB so a mono PA hears the bypass level exactly; one side alone stays within ±2 dB in bands

presets.name: Tight funk
presets.desc: Rhythm parts with the pick centred and punchy and the ring blooming wide behind it
presets.notes: Allpass smears nothing; transient focus ducks the side on each stroke

presets.name: Wall rhythm
presets.desc: Detuned width around a dry centre for high-gain rhythm after the cab; the fold cannot comb
presets.notes: Exact Double: the voices live in the side only, so a mono PA hears the dry riff; high cut keeps the fizz centred

presets.name: Studio double
presets.desc: The classic micro-shift double: two detuned, slightly late voices left and right, heard in mono too
presets.notes: Classic law: the fold carries the double as a chorus; Mono Error shows it

presets.name: Vocal spread
presets.desc: A lead or backing voice widened by detuned voices in the side; sibilants stay centred
presets.notes: High cut 6 kHz keeps esses and breaths in the middle; the fold is the dry voice

presets.name: Air pad
presets.desc: Keys or ambient guitar opened past the speakers: correlation below zero, mono fold still exact
presets.notes: For headphones and recordings rather than a PA: a side louder than the mid reads as outside the speakers

presets.name: Bass sheen
presets.desc: Bass with its lows mono and dry and only the top spread wide
presets.notes: Side-only crossover at 300 Hz: the fundamental never moves; Allpass keeps the attack unsmeared

presets.name: Old pseudo-stereo
presets.desc: The complementary-comb pseudo-stereo of the fifties, exact in mono
presets.notes: Lauridsen's comb: flat in bands but periodic, the classic phasey stereo of reissues

presets.name: Haas pan
presets.desc: A true precedence shift: the right side a few ms late, the image pulled left; combs in mono
presets.notes: Studio, stereo playback only: Mono Error shows the comb the fold takes (notches at 33, 100, 167 Hz)

presets.name: Narrow the keys
presets.desc: A stereo keyboard brought in from the edges, its lows made mono
presets.notes: M/S width only; the mid is untouched

presets.name: Mono the lows
presets.desc: A stereo synth or backing with everything below 180 Hz made mono, the rest untouched
presets.notes: The vinyl and live rule, on the side only: the dry mid never sees a filter

presets.name: Place left
presets.desc: A guitar lane widened and placed left of centre without touching its mono fold
presets.notes: Pair with Place right on the other guitarist: different variants keep the two images distinct

presets.name: Place right
presets.desc: A guitar lane widened and placed right of centre without touching its mono fold
presets.notes: The partner of Place left: variant 3 against its 2

presets.name: Turn the keys
presets.desc: A stereo keyboard image rotated off-centre to the right, its spread kept
presets.notes: A true rotation of a stereo source; it moves the fold (stated), use Balance for a mono lane

presets.name: Width swell
presets.desc: Stereo opening with the expression pedal, from mono to fully decorrelated
presets.notes: Map EXP to Amount 0 - 100 %: the fold stays the dry at every position, no zipper
